templates.title: Welcome to Example MSP!
templates.body_html: This page walks {{client_name}} through how we work together: who to contact, how billing works and how to stay safe online.

templates.title: How our billing platform works
templates.body_html: Invoices arrive by email on the first of the month and can be paid online by card or bank transfer.

templates.title: Email security basics
templates.body_html: Our email filter stops spam and dangerous messages before they reach you. The guide below shows how to release a message you were expecting.
